quote: تسجيل 466 حالة وفاة بسبب سوء التغذية والتجويع منذ عام 2024
caveat: Ministry press statement for World Food Day, 16 October 2026. The quote reads: 466 deaths recorded from malnutrition and starvation since 2024. The same statement gives 157 children and 189 older people among them. Israeli officials rejected the famine findings and have said some publicised cases involved underlying illness.
